description: ΚΥΚΛΟΦΟΡΙΑΚΗ ΜΕΛΕΤΗ ΝΗΡΕΑ-ΠΡΩΤΕΑ-ΟΡΕΙΧΑΛΚΟΥΡΓΩΝ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΜΑΡΙΑ ΜΑΙΣΤΡΕΛΛΗ. Med henblik på at informere og inddrage borgerne om spørgsmål i deres dagligdag afholdt Rafina-Pikermi kommune sammen med den forskønnende NIREA-forening onsdag den 29. juli et møde for interesserede beboere i NIREA-PROTEA-OREICHALKOURGON for at informere, om en evaluering og eventuelle bemærkninger til den foreslåede trafikundersøgelse af området. Coverage: ΜΑΡΙΑ ΜΑΙΣΤΡΕΛΛΗ. The portal shows the English title as "ÉTUDE DE TRAFIC DE NEREA-PROTEA-OREICHARGON" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΜΑΡΙΑ ΜΑΙΣΤΡΕΛΛΗ. Its keywords include repository.data.gov.gr, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 2026-02-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
